title: The GOAT Debate Just Got Spicier After LeBron James' Latest Self-Confidence Bombshell - NewsBreak
text:
By Manhaz Muntaha ,
2 hours ago The Los Angeles Lakers superstar LeBron James wrapped up his record-setting 23rd NBA season on a high note. Although Los Angeles saw its playoff run come to an end after being swept by the Oklahoma City Thunder in the second round, the 41-year-old once again proved that he remains one of the league’s elite performers. His impact on and off the court was recently recognized when he was selected as the cover athlete for TIME100 Sports’ list of the 100 Most Influential People in Sports for 2026.
LeBron James Makes Fearless Claim About His Place Among NBA Greats Over the course of more than two decades in the NBA, James has assembled one of the most decorated resumes in basketball history. Unsurprisingly, when asked about where he ranks among the game’s legends, the four-time champion showed no hesitation in backing himself.
“I’m not taking nobody over me,” LeBron said . “There’s no question. But I think Mike will say the same thing. Rest his soul, Kobe will say the same thing. Magic will say the same thing.
“Bird will say the same thing. Shaq could say the same thing. The late great Wilt. Kareem. I don’t think none of us are going to take somebody else. If there’s a general manager and he’s eyeballing all of us on a baseline, with the No. 1 pick, it’s gonna be hard not to take me, champ.”
Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Lakers forward LeBron James (23) controls the ball against Oklahoma City Thunder guard Luguentz Dort (5) during the first half in game four of the second round of the 2026 NBA Playoffs at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Gary A. Vasquez-Imagn Images As the greatest-of-all-time debate continues, LeBron remains one of the central figures in the discussion alongside Michael Jordan . The Lakers star has delivered championships to every franchise he has played for and continues to perform at an elite level long after many of his peers have retired. As speculation about retirement continues to follow him, James revealed that his decision will ultimately come down to his passion for the daily grind of basketball rather than physical limitations.
“Where the mind goes, the body will lay,” he said. “When I’m not in love with getting to the arenas on game days five hours before to start my preparation, if I’m out of love with getting to practice 2½ hours beforehand, then I know I’ll be done. Because then I’m going to start cheating the game.”
James is currently a free agent following the expiration of his contract with the Lakers. Many NBA insiders expect him to re-sign with Los Angeles. However, rumors have also connected him to a possible return to his hometown franchise, the Cleveland Cavaliers.
LeBron James Fires Back at Bronny James Critics During the same interview, James also addressed the criticism surrounding his son, Bronny James, and his NBA journey.
“The kid has earned his right to be a professional athlete,” James said . “The thing you’re not going to do is throw stones at us as a family. I’m not letting that sh-t slide, because I know what I’ve created because of what I didn’t have. So if you want to talk about the kid, that he shouldn’t be an NBA player, I don’t care about that. As long as you don’t get to the fatherhood piece. I don’t play those games.”
When the Lakers selected Bronny in the draft, many critics claimed that LeBron’s influence played a significant role in the decision. However, after a modest rookie campaign, Bronny showed noticeable development during his second season, particularly through his performances in the G League.
Despite the scrutiny surrounding their journey, LeBron and Bronny have already secured a unique place in basketball history. The pair became the NBA’s only active father-son duo.
